{{Quote|I had had my suspicions for several weeks, but had no proof until two days ago. It seems Calder was seeing my wife. Right under my nose, no less!|Handon Guld, to Revan about his wife's affair|<ref name="KOTOR" />}}
The '''wife''' of the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Handon Guld]] lived with him on the [[Farm/Legends|agrarian]] [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]] during the [[Jedi Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Sith Empire]].<ref name="KOTOR" /> In [[3956 BBY]],<ref name="EA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' places the events of ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]'', in which [[Handon Guld]]'s wife is mentioned, in [[3956 BBY]].</ref> she had an [[Reproduction/Legends|affair]] with another [[Colonist/Legends|colonist]] named [[Calder Nettic]], which was suspected and eventually discovered by her [[Marriage/Legends|husband]] and resulted in their [[Divorce/Legends|divorce]].<ref name="KOTOR" />

Guld and [[Rickard Lusoff]], Nettic's former business partner, each individually planned to [[Death/Legends|murder]] Nettic. Two [[Standard day/Legends|days]] later, they stalked Nettic through Dantooine's [[Ancient Grove (Dantooine)|Ancient Grove]]. Guld killed the man with a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]], and Lusoff shot with his own, accidentally hitting Guld instead. [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Bolook]] and former [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan]], who had [[Amnesia/Legends|amnesia]] and was [[Jedi training/Legends|retraining]] as a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]],<ref name="KOTOR" /> carried out an investigation into the murder,<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|I|374|Guld, Handon}}</ref> during which Guld admitted his knowledge of his wife's infidelity.<ref name="KOTOR" /> Both men were arrested<ref name="CSWE" /> and brought to the nearby [[Jedi Enclave]].<ref name="KOTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Well if you can't keep her, it's your own fault.|Canderous Ordo in potential dialogue|<ref name="KOTOR" />}}
Handon Guld's wife was mentioned in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]'', developed by [[BioWare]]. The mention occurs in dialogue during the optional side quest "Murdered Settler," which does not change the player's alignment. The quest will always trigger in a cutscene if the player passes by a small bridge within the Ancient Grove on Dantooine. The quest can be refused or dropped,<ref name="KOTOR" /> but the [[2008]] reference book ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' confirms that both men were arrested, so the quest must have been [[canon]]ically completed.<ref name="CSWE" /> When Guld speaks to Revan about his wife's affair, if he is in the player's party, the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Canderous Ordo]] will comment on it, saying that it is Guld's fault for being unable to keep her.<ref name="KOTOR" />
